IncidentBot: [P1] High tail latency detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Alerting oncall rotation. Incident ID: INC-2026-089. Metrics spike >300ms at 1768504300.
Alex: taking this one now, joining bridge.
Mira: I'm coming onshift in 10m — do you want me to take over driver when I'm live?
Alex: yes pls. I'm primary until 1768504600 (30m from now). After that I'd like to hand driver to Mira. Comm owner needed — can someone own updates and public/status updates?
Sam: I can be comms if needed, but heads up I have a 15m sync at 1768504460 and might be slow to reply.
Jo: I can do comms during Sam's meeting window.
Alex: ok plan: I'm driver until 1768504600, Mira will be primary after that. Sam will be comms first 10m, Jo will cover during Sam's meeting and then Sam can resume. Does that work?
Mira: works for me. Quick notes: if we need rollback of the most recent model variant, run the deploy-rollback script in infra-runbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollback (private).
Alex: putting runbook snippet here for quick pace:
```
# check tail latency by pod
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=generator -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=generator --since=10m | grep latency
# if seeding mismatch, run: /opt/redwood/bin/infer-regen --variant stable
```
Jo: I see error 504s on gateway logs starting at ~1768504285, probably an upstream timeout to model-backend. I'll start tracing to model-backend nodes.
Sam: can someone check GPU utilization + KV cache hit rate? I'll open the observability dashboard.
Mira: @Alex if you hand off driver to me, should I place canary fallback to smaller model for latency? Is that allowed by current routing policy?
Alex: yes, policy allows emergency fallback. Steps in routing-runbook: set route param fallback=true for route /v1/generate in the console, or use API: POST /admin/route/update {"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"small-latency"}. I'll paste exact curl in a sec.
Alex: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.internal/api/admin/route/update -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"gpt-medium-q4_0"}'
Jo: doing a quick config check — config sync shows no recent deploys to model-backend in last hour. Might be transient load spike.
Sam: digging into GPU metrics now: one node in cluster eu-west-1 has 98% GPU mem and is OOM-killing some workers at 1768504260; might be cross-region routing leak.
Alex: interesting — we saw a routing change earlier today. @Mira when you take over, please remove eu-west-1 from preferred region for this route and force us-west-2 only for next 30m.
Mira: ack, I'll apply region restriction when I take driver.
Jo: comms update draft: "We're investigating increased latency for text generation in us-west-2. Engineers are actively mitigating; some traffic is being routed to fallback models to preserve availability. We'll update in 15m." Want to run that by legal?
Sam: legal OK on status language. Add note: "no PII exposed" if applicable.
Alex: timeline + ownership:
- 1768504321 Incident created (Alex primary driver)
- 1768504400 Sam posted initial metrics check
- 1768504460 Sam meeting window starts — Jo covering comms
- 1768504600 Mira to take over driver (planned)
Mira: on call handoff now. I'm driving. Alex staying on slack for 10m as secondary.
Alex: handing over: current findings: gateway 504s, one eu-west GPU node thrashing, fallback route ready but not yet enabled. Rolling a conservative fallback if latency doesn't improve in 5m. Logs: /var/log/gateway/errors.gz (most 504 traces).
Jo: comms update posted to #status with incident id INC-2026-089 and short blurb. Also DM to key PMs.
Sam: I've opened ticket to infra to cordon that eu-west node: TCK-4521. Notifying infra.
Mira: applying region restriction now. Command I used: `rbctl route update --route /v1/generate --regions us-west-2 --force` — confirmed applied.
IncidentBot: Region restriction applied by Mira at 1768504595.
Jo: customers on the impacted list (top 10) have been emailed a short note.
Alex: thanks. I'll remain available as secondary. If latency keeps above 250ms for next 10m escalate to P1 on-call manager and consider model fallback.
Mira: monitoring graphs stabilizing after region restriction. KV cache hit rate recovering.
Sam: infra acknowledged cordon ticket, investigating OOM cause.
Jo: continuing comms until we have stable metrics for 20m.
Mira: taking formal ownership of driver. Final handoff: driver=Mira, comms=Jo (covering Sam's meeting window), secondary=Alex.
Alex: closing my primary window, will be on-call as secondary and reachable. Good handoff. :white_check_mark:
Jo: noted. I'll keep status page updates every 15m or on material changes.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-089 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Last update 1768504700.
Mira: closing thread, thanks team.
